name: Local Conditional Extremum
description: Replaced the global determinant product condition with a local sum condition for each node. The target average value (3) is not a global extremum for the channel load (which ranges from 2 to 4), preventing simple global bounding arguments. Bipartiteness can only be deduced by observing that the local extremum depends on the node's own state, forcing all neighbors to take the opposite state.
